announcements.summary: The Board of Directors of OnMobile Global Limited ("the Company'') at their meeting held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 in Bangalore, through zoom video conference, has inter alia, pursuant to Regulation 33 of Listing Regulations, considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results as per IND- AS for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the Unaudited Financial Statements (Standalone & Consolidated) along with the Limited Review Report of the auditors is enclosed herewith. The meeting of the Board of Directors commenced at 08:30 PM IST and concluded at 10.30 PM IST.
OnMobile Global Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 28, 2026, titled "OnMobile Reports Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027 Results".

announcements.summary: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part B of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform you that the Company has entered into a Distribution Agreement with Savex Technologies Private Limited on 28th October 2026 for the distribution of the Company's ONMO+ Smart Console, its gaming hardware with bundled digital services, in India through authorised large format retail, regional retail, e-commerce and quick-commerce channels on a stock-and-sale basis.This arrangement extends the availability of the Company s ONMO+ Smart Console from its existing online presence to organised retail and marketplace channels across India through a large and established national distributor of technology and consumer electronics products.

This is to inform you that OnMobile Global Limited is issuing a press release titled  OnMobile Partners with Savex Technologies to Expand ONMO+ Smart Console Distribution Across India , a copy of which is enclosed herewith.
